F4 definitions (batch 7 §2 F4 step 1). Full text: `code/cas/s06-xcheck/README.md` on `abhijit/xcheck-s06` @ 22fcc7c1. Computing now; no answer needed unless you disagree.

**Conventions.** Classical T_ℓ / U_ℓ on q-expansions (PARI `mfheckemat`); eigenvalue = a_ℓ(g), |a_ℓ| ≤ 2ℓ^{(k−1)/2}. T_k(N) = ℤ-algebra generated by all T_n (incl. T_p, U_q), computed as ℤ-span of T_1..T_B, B ≥ Sturm. ord_𝔓 normalised to 1 on a uniformiser; e, f recorded.

**T4.** T(1) = T_k(1) on S_k(SL₂(ℤ)); 𝔪 = (17, T_ℓ − τ(ℓ), all ℓ incl. ℓ = 17); τ(17) ≡ 10 mod 17, so 𝔪 is ordinary and e = id on T(1)_𝔪. δ = 16 − 3^{2−k}T_3² (classical T_3), computed via x = 16·3^{k−2} − T_3² (same ideal). length_{ℤ₁₇} T(1)_𝔪/(δ) = Σ_{(g,𝔓)∈𝔪} f(𝔓)·ord_𝔓 δ(g) (route A), cross-checked by `matsnf` of x on the ℤ-lattice T(1) (route B, all 𝔪' at 17). t_{G_k}(3) := ord_𝔓(a₃(G_k)² − 16·3^{k−2}) from the eigenform's coefficient (stage tex H1). Extra: at level 3, ord 𝔠₃(f') and t^{an}_{f'}(3) for the 3-new f' in 𝔪_N = (𝔪, U₃ − ε3^{(k−2)/2}).

**H3.** 𝔠_q(f) = λ_f(𝔟_k)O_𝔓, 𝔟_k = ker(T_k(q) → End(S^old)), S^old = span{g(z), g(qz): g ∈ S_k(1)}, T_k(q) contains U_q. t_f(q): the Galois exponent is not computable from q-expansions; we compute t^{an}_f(q) = ord_𝔓 λ_f(ker(T^{an} → End S^old)), T^{an} generated by T_ℓ, ℓ ∤ qp (no U_q). ord 𝔠 ≤ t^{an} ≤ t_f(q) always (second ≤ by Carayol); t ≤ t^{an} is R=T at level M ([KO 3.14]). So ord 𝔠 − t^{an} tests step (5) of prop:s06-levM.

**Doubts.**
1. **H3 is vacuous at M = 1 for these triples**: S_4(1) = S_6(1) = 0, so S^old = 0, 𝔠_q(f) = (1), t^{an} = 0 for every f; and the Galois t_f(q) = 0 for every non-Eisenstein 𝔪 (no irreducible level-1 ρ̄ for p ≤ 7). The difference is 0 trivially and does not test prop:s06-levM. Also, for q ≡ −1 mod p and even k, E_k satisfies level raising at q mod p, so Eisenstein 𝔪 with q-new forms are expected (outside (H2); listed separately). A non-vacuous M = 1 test needs k ≥ 12, p ≥ 13 (k ≤ p−1), p | q+1, a_q(g) ≡ 0: for Δ, p = 13 the smallest q is 1741; p = 17: q = 2311.
2. t_{G_k}(3) = ord δ(G_k) identically (3 is a unit), so in T4 it is a second route, not a second quantity; the level-3 extra is the genuinely different check.
3. δ is independent of the T'_q/T''_q choice as long as T'_qT''_q = q^{2−k}T_q².
